description: The Classic BLT is a timeless American sandwich, beloved for its simple yet perfect combination of crispy bacon, crisp lettuce, and juicy ripe tomatoes. Layered between perfectly toasted bread and a generous slather of mayonnaise, it is a comforting and satisfying lunch that never goes out of style. This iconic sandwich celebrates fresh ingredients and a delightful texture contrast in every bite.

instructions.title: Cook the Bacon
instructions.text: Place bacon slices in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook until crispy, turning occasionally. This usually takes about 8-10 minutes. Once cooked, transfer the bacon to a plate lined with paper towels to drain excess fat.

instructions.title: Toast the Bread
instructions.text: While the bacon drains, toast the bread slices to your desired crispness. You can use a toaster, a toaster oven, or lightly pan-fry them in a clean skillet or even a little of the reserved bacon fat for extra flavor.

instructions.title: Prepare Vegetables
instructions.text: Wash and thoroughly dry the lettuce leaves. Slice the ripe tomatoes into even 1/4-inch thick rounds. Season the tomato slices lightly with salt and freshly ground black pepper to enhance their flavor.

instructions.title: Spread the Mayonnaise
instructions.text: Once the toast is ready, spread a generous layer of mayonnaise on one side of each slice. Ensure an even coating from edge to edge.

instructions.title: Assemble the BLT
instructions.text: Begin assembling your sandwich. On four of the mayonnaise-coated toast slices, layer the crisp lettuce, followed by the seasoned tomato slices. Arrange 3 slices of crispy bacon on top of the tomatoes for each sandwich.

instructions.title: Finish and Serve
instructions.text: Place the remaining four mayonnaise-coated toast slices on top of the bacon to complete each sandwich. Gently press down. For easier eating, carefully slice each BLT diagonally in half before serving immediately.

tips: For truly crispy bacon, start with a cold pan and cook slowly over medium-low heat to render the fat evenly. Do not overcrowd the pan.
Always use the freshest, ripest summer tomatoes you can find; they are the heart of a great BLT. Heirloom tomatoes add fantastic color and flavor.
Do not skip the mayonnaise, and apply it generously! It provides essential moisture and richness that ties all the simple ingredients together perfectly.
